title: Next Special Palindrome Number
summary: Given an integer n, find the smallest palindrome where each digit k appears exactly k times, and this palindrome is greater than n.
statement: Given an integer n, find the smallest palindrome where each digit k appears exactly k times, and this palindrome is greater than n.
constraints: A present digit d must occur exactly d times.
Return the smallest qualifying palindrome strictly greater than n.
hints: A palindrome’s digit counts allow at most one included odd digit, which must occupy the center.
Enumerate valid digit subsets, permute only their half-counts, and mirror each half.
Generate every valid special palindrome through length seventeen, sort them, then binary-search strictly after n.
Every valid palindrome has exactly one generated half multiset and center; mirroring enumerates all arrangements, and upper-bound search chooses the least greater value.
editorial: Every valid palindrome has exactly one generated half multiset and center; mirroring enumerates all arrangements, and upper-bound search chooses the least greater value.

tests.explanation: Twenty-two is the first larger palindrome with digit two appearing twice.
Two hundred twelve is next; digit one occurs once and digit two occurs twice.
